scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client && tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
